<?php
// authentication_optimized.php
// Production-friendly authentication endpoint
// - Supports DB-backed users via PDO when DATABASE_DSN is provided
// - Falls back to environment-configured user (AUTH_USER + AUTH_PASS_HASH)
// - Uses password_hash / password_verify, prepared statements, session management
// - Basic rate-limiting (per-session) to mitigate brute-force
// - Returns JSON responses and proper HTTP status codes

declare(strict_types=1);

// Configuration: set these in your environment or server config (not in code)
// Example (bash):
// export AUTH_USER=admin
// export AUTH_PASS_HASH='$2y$10$...'
// export DATABASE_DSN='mysql:host=127.0.0.1;dbname=app;charset=utf8mb4'
// export DATABASE_USER='dbuser'
// export DATABASE_PASS='dbpass'

// Minimal hardening constants
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;           // max failed attempts
const ATTEMPT_WINDOW = 900;      // seconds (15 minutes)
const MAX_USERNAME_LEN = 128;
const MAX_PASSWORD_LEN = 256;

session_start();

// Simple JSON responder
function respond(int $code, array $payload): void
{
    http_response_code($code);
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

// Read input (JSON preferred, fallback to form-data)
function get_input(): array
{
    $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';
    if (stripos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
        $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
        $data = json_decode($raw, true);
        if (is_array($data)) return $data;
    }
    // Fallback to POST params
    return $_POST;
}

// Simple per-session rate limiter
if (!isset($_SESSION['auth_attempts'])) {
    $_SESSION['auth_attempts'] = ['count' => 0, 'first_ts' => time()];
}

$now = time();
$attempts = &$_SESSION['auth_attempts'];
if ($now - ($attempts['first_ts'] ?? 0) > ATTEMPT_WINDOW) {
    // reset window
    $attempts['count'] = 0;
    $attempts['first_ts'] = $now;
}

if ($attempts['count'] >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    respond(429, ['error' => 'Too many attempts. Try again later.']);
}

$input = get_input();
$username = isset($input['username']) ? trim((string)$input['username']) : '';
$password = isset($input['password']) ? (string)$input['password'] : '';

// Basic validation
if ($username === '' || $password === '') {
    respond(400, ['error' => 'Missing username or password.']);
}
if (strlen($username) > MAX_USERNAME_LEN || strlen($password) > MAX_PASSWORD_LEN) {
    respond(400, ['error' => 'Input too long.']);
}

// Primary authentication flow: database-backed if DSN provided
$dsn = getenv('DATABASE_DSN');
if ($dsn !== false && $dsn !== '') {
    try {
        $dbUser = getenv('DATABASE_USER') ?: '';
        $dbPass = getenv('DATABASE_PASS') ?: '';
        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $dbUser, $dbPass, [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
        ]);

        // Expect a table `users` with columns `username` (unique) and `password_hash`
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT id, username, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = :u LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([':u' => $username]);
        $userRow = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($userRow && isset($userRow['password_hash']) && password_verify($password, $userRow['password_hash'])) {
            // Successful auth
            session_regenerate_id(true);
            $_SESSION['user_id'] = $userRow['id'];
            $_SESSION['username'] = $userRow['username'];
            $attempts['count'] = 0; // reset
            respond(200, ['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Authenticated']);
        }

        // fall through to failure handler
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        // Do not leak internal errors to clients; log server-side instead
        error_log('Auth DB error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        respond(500, ['error' => 'Internal server error.']);
    }
}

// Fallback: environment-configured single user (use hashed password)
$envUser = getenv('AUTH_USER') ?: '';
$envHash = getenv('AUTH_PASS_HASH') ?: '';
if ($envUser !== '' && $envHash !== '') {
    // Safe username comparison
    if (hash_equals($envUser, $username) && password_verify($password, $envHash)) {
        session_regenerate_id(true);
        $_SESSION['user_id'] = 'env:' . $envUser;
        $_SESSION['username'] = $envUser;
        $attempts['count'] = 0;
        respond(200, ['ok' => true, 'message' => 'Authenticated (env)']);
    }
    // otherwise fail
}

// Authentication failed
$attempts['count']++;
respond(401, ['error' => 'Invalid credentials.']);

// Notes for operators:
// - Never set AUTH_PASS_HASH to a plain password. Generate it with password_hash('strongpass', PASSWORD_DEFAULT).
// - Prefer a DB with secure password hashes and unique username constraints.
// - For production, place this behind HTTPS and consider additional protections: IP-based throttling, CAPTCHA for many failures,
//   device fingerprinting, MFA (TOTP / WebAuthn), and enforcement of strong password policies.
?>

- Input handling accepts JSON or form POST and validates input length.
